gate: list-excellences; admit as open conceptual hypotheses
limits: One-context phase sweep, not independent enumeration
No field validation or novelty search
Authored reading order; no measured smoothness or discovered spectrum

repairs.before: are emergency contributions compensated without converting today's indispensability into unlimited control over the lives and work made possible afterward
repairs.after: is the rescuer's compensation bounded and dated, or does it include open-ended governance rights or a perpetual share of post-rescue output
repairs.why: Fable critic found the initial fairness judgment insufficiently operational
Moved from joint-problem phase to reciprocal commitment

distinctness_note: Necessity leverage at consent and open-ended rescue compensation at settlement are deliberately distinct phases, not two names for one check.
